title: Veloscuro - Windstorm
description:
Windstorm explores movement, atmosphere and human presence across vast desert landscapes shaped by wind, dust and silence.

Somewhere between memory, fashion and dream, sculptural forms move through storm-filled plains.

Created using original music, lyrics and visual art and the ever evolving digital tools.

Listen to Veloscuro: The Shape of Dust album with single "Windstorm" - On Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music and all major streaming platforms - https://artists.landr.com/991048428164
